annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines unveiled to position Mauritius as a high-tech, innovation-driven economy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (Mauritius); Government Information Service (GIS)
annotation.summary_en: Mauritian government news release (10 April 2026) announcing the launch of the National AI Strategy and the FAIR Guidelines (Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness, Integrity, Responsibility) by the AI Unit, along with an AI Unit website, a Regional AI Marketplace, the DIVA virtual assistant, and awards for a road-safety AI video competition.
key_provisions_or_claims: The National AI Strategy and FAIR Guidelines set out a framework for ethical, transparent AI adoption in Mauritius
The FAIR principles are Fairness, Accountability, Inclusiveness, Integrity and Responsibility
The AI Unit's website was launched as a governance hub, together with a Regional AI Marketplace
The government plans startup registration support and AI skills training, and aims at regional opportunities in Africa
The government launched the DIVA AI virtual assistant to improve public service delivery
